name: Yumetsukuri Monster
source:
Who would request this?
Who would imagine this?
It's somebody's wish. Somebody's idea.

The "dreams" of someone special come true. Let's weave an end to them.

One day, Haru's elder sister investigated his dreams. It seemed dubious, but his dreams were coming true by the power of extrasensory perception (ESP). But it was at the cost of the life of another. It was no miracle. These dreams-come-true were sinister...

While trying to learn the origin of his power, Haru met Yumeri, a lone young girl... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE094852.html]DLsite English[/url]]
